excerpt: 1998: First collisions July 23, 1998. • 1999-2007: Y4S data for BaBar (433 fb-1) • 2008: Y2S (30 fb-1), Y3S (15 fb-1), and small energy scan for BaBar. • 2008: Turned off PEP-II April 7, 2008.
title: The Last Year of PEP-II B-Factory Operation (EPAC 2008 talk, J. Seeman for the PEP-II Team)
